904_cardinality_and_ownership.count_rule: Count complete semicolon/full-stop entries in the two reproduced Latin lists, retaining original case forms; not normalized concept classes and not inferred icon count.
904_cardinality_and_ownership.reading_layer: Valentina Cacopardo, Memory and Imagination in the Ars Memorativa in Fifteenth-Century Italy, PhD, Warburg Institute, University of London,2021, printed pp88–89, notes208/210.
904_cardinality_and_ownership.historical_witness: BnF nouvelles acquisitions latines635, Secretum de thesauro experimentorum ymaginationis hominum, dated c1430 by this thesis; source list block ff85v–88r.
904_cardinality_and_ownership.edition_ownership: Thesis quotes the decoded Latin after Eugenio Battisti and Giuseppa Saccaro Battisti, Le macchine cifrate di Giovanni Fontana, Milan1984. This producer read the thesis, not the full1984 edition and not those native folios. Precise line-by-line native ownership remains for direct collation.
904_cardinality_and_ownership.figure_ownership: The fourteen symbol-list entries are textual examples. This producer has not verified fourteen corresponding drawings or a native mirror/sign figure. Thesis fig9 belongs to Speculum f21r, not to these symbolic lists; figs14–15 belong to optical examples ff45r–45v, also not these lists.
904_cardinality_and_ownership.providencia_limit: Preserve the Latin providencia as a source reading. The thesis translates prudence, but this is not an automatic universal equivalence and gives no Voynich lexeme. No silently normalized prudentia is introduced.
904_cardinality_and_ownership.retained_ambiguity: Holding a mirror in the virtue list versus mirrors in the science list differs in carrier construction; this can discriminate the entries without a separately written namespace operator. IDEA904 stays RAW/unreviewed.

single_followup_candidate.name: Observer-induced appearance change with explicit preservation of the object or non-mixture of bodies
single_followup_candidate.whole_source_scope: Entire De possibilitate ymaginum artis, introduction plus eight experimenta plus conclusion, NAL635 ff43r–46v. The thesis reproduces the eight paragraphs, but rearranges their discussion order as1,2,5,6,8,3,4,7. Native argument order remains1–8; do not treat thesis exposition order as manuscript order.
single_followup_candidate.fifth_complete_quoted_latin: QUINTUM EXPERIMENTUM Item si oculus aliquod obiectum videns indebite comprimatur, duas res vid<e>re iudicabit, quod non ponendo rerum similitudines non salvari potest, cum res visa ponatur una.
single_followup_candidate.fifth_pin: f44v; note242; brackets retained from reproduced text.
single_followup_candidate.eighth_complete_quoted_latin: OCTAVUM EXPERIMENTUM Aliud pro nunc exemplum erit, si bene notaverimus quando per vitrum [46r] coloratum, tanquam per medium, alia colorata inspicimus, ubi neuter color sed quaxi medium aparet. Et cum illa corpor<a> se penetrare non videantur, credendum est formarum suarum permistionem fieri in medio et oculo, etc.
single_followup_candidate.finite_unequal_consequence: In5, apparent plurality coexists with one observed object. In8, altered perceived colour coexists with bodies not penetrating one another; the claimed mixture belongs to forms in the medium/eye. A literal material-replication/material-blending reading cannot retain those explicit invariant-object and non-mixture clauses merely by supplying a different product name. A representation-level reading can. This is a constraint within the historical argument, not an experimentally verified medieval optical theory.
single_followup_candidate.full_argument_obligation: The introduction argues for images against doubts about them, and the conclusion refers the reader to psychology/optics. Dreams, absent/dead people, mirrors, celestial reflections, afterimages and distant shapes are other parts of that argument. They are not all physical manufacturing instructions. A purported whole reading must retain these changes of evidential example without turning unparsed groups into setup padding.
single_followup_candidate.possible_authoring_use: One hypothetical repeated construction could distinguish appearance from material predication, with the observer/medium condition changing while the object reference persists. It would need to generate both the altered percept and the explicit invariant-object/non-mixture clause from written material. No target term, number word, observer or source identity is assigned here.
single_followup_candidate.why_likely_useless_now: The discriminating negative and object-identity assertions are readable in Fontana, but currently unbound in any selected whole native account. Merely inserting observer/image/object English names creates another coherent story; illustrations with doubled shapes or coloured boundaries do not independently identify those assertions. A freely renamed model of perception can still preserve all local relations.
single_followup_candidate.retention_decision: No further new RAW card. Existing IDEA351 already retains whole optical object/image accounts, IDEA593 preserves material identity despite changed appearance, and IDEA879 preserves actual versus apparent properties under viewing context. This exact two-example source is useful specific content, but a new general appearance-versus-material card would largely duplicate that surplus without a changed native consequence.

additional_author_commitment_not_selecte.quote: QUATUOR DOCUMENTA ARISTOTELIS [= Thomas, lectio5, para13] Aristoteles quatuor tradit nobis documenta: primum ut retinenda deducat in ordinem; secundum ut profunde mentem aponat; tertium ut frequenter meditetur secundum ordinem; quartum ut incipiat reminisce a principio. Et hec stabilem memoriam faciunt.
additional_author_commitment_not_selecte.limit: This prescribes ordering, sustained attention, ordered repetition and beginning recollection at the start. It does not prescribe a written line reset, common machine endpoint, bijective cipher or repeat-each-word encoding. No new proposal is made from it.
